purpose_context: doc-kitty already lets a consumer override its vocabulary, section registry, and theme, but those governance knobs are scattered and undocumented as one thing, and a few (doc_status, required fields) are still hardcoded. This mission consolidates the shipped seams under a single, portable 'documentation charter' surface, closes the last hardcoded knobs, and fulfils the convention's standing promise to be recast as a charter/doctrine — without coupling adopters to the Spec Kitty engine.
purpose_tldr: Give adopters one coherent, doc-kitty-native place to govern their documentation convention — no Spec Kitty runtime required.
